title: Strategy
sub: A strategy is a named set of rules. Each rule reads as one sentence: tap an underlined value to change it.
loadError: The strategies could not be loaded: {error}

list.title: My strategies
list.sub: Pick a strategy to edit, or create one.
list.empty: No strategy yet. Create one, then add rules.
list.rules: {count, plural, =0 {no rules} one {# rule} other {# rules}}

noPortfolio.title: No simulated portfolio yet
noPortfolio.body: A strategy acts on a portfolio. Start by choosing one; the rules take their targets from its weights.

editor.noRules: This strategy has no rule yet. Add one to start.
editor.orderNote: On the same day, the rules act in this order: {order}. The same rule does not fire again within {days} trading days, and an order under {min} is not placed.
editor.askAgentMessage: Help me complete my strategy "{name}". It has {count, plural, =0 {no rules} one {# rule} other {# rules}}: {rules}. Propose rule cards I can confirm.

allocation_target.name: Rebalancing
allocation_target.desc: Brings the portfolio back to target weights, every quarter or when the gap grows too wide.

weight_cap.name: Weight cap
weight_cap.desc: Keeps any single holding from going over a set share of the portfolio.

drawdown_guard.name: Drawdown guard
drawdown_guard.desc: After a marked fall from the peak, moves part of the portfolio to a defensive holding.

periodic_purchase.name: Periodic contribution
periodic_purchase.desc: Adds a fixed amount at a regular interval, split by the target weights.

price_threshold.name: Price threshold
price_threshold.desc: Simulates an acquisition or a reduction when a holding crosses a price.

sentence.allocation_target_drift: <mode>When the gap from target goes over</mode> <drift>{driftV}</drift>, bring the portfolio back to <targets>{targetsV}</targets>.
sentence.allocation_target_quarterly: <mode>Every quarter</mode>, bring the portfolio back to <targets>{targetsV}</targets>.
sentence.weight_cap: If a holding goes over <cap>{capV}</cap> of the portfolio, reduce the position to the cap and put the excess <dest>{destV}</dest>.
sentence.drawdown_guard: If the fall from the peak goes over <trigger>{triggerV}</trigger>, move <move>{moveV}</move> of the other holdings to <symbol>{symbolV}</symbol>; come back when the fall is under <recover>{recoverV}</recover> again.
sentence.periodic_purchase_month: <every>Every month</every>, add <amount>{amountV}</amount> of new money, split by the target weights.
sentence.periodic_purchase_days: <every>Every</every> <n>{nV}</n>, add <amount>{amountV}</amount> of new money, split by the target weights.

chip.modeDrift: When the gap goes over a threshold
chip.targetsHint: By default, the current weights of the simulated portfolio. The rest stays in cash.

live.sub: The rules are evaluated on the simulated portfolio as it stands now. Nothing is executed.
